entities.summary: Ana Lilian de la Macorra Apéllaniz is a Mexican psychologist, who worked as a producer and actress in the well-known Mexican sitcoms, El Chavo del Ocho and El Chapulín Colorado in the late 1970s until obtaining the permanent role of Paty in 1978 in El Chavo.
